summary: Lays out related buttons as one unit, either spaced (an action bar or dialog footer) or attached (a segmented control), and gives the group one accessible name.
whenToUse: Footers of dialogs, forms and cards: primary at the end, alternatives before it.
Attached: two to five closely related choices of equal weight, like Unified or Split diff.
whenNotToUse: Switching between views of content: use Tabs, which manage the panel and arrow-key navigation.
A single choice that persists as a setting: use RadioGroup.

dos.title: Put the primary action last
dos.text: Users read the alternatives on the way to the main action, and the primary lands where the eye ends.

donts.title: Mix variants in an attached group
donts.text: An attached group reads as one control. Mixed fills break it into unrelated pieces.

accessibility: Renders role="group". Pass aria-label when the buttons are related choices so the group is announced.
Each button stays in the tab order; the focused button lifts above its neighbors so the ring is never clipped.
Vertical groups stack the same buttons; the tab order follows the visual order.
contentGuidelines: Labels in one group share a grammatical form: all verbs, or all nouns for view choices.
Keep attached groups to five items or fewer.
